abilities.name: Reaper's Mark
abilities.text: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.text: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100 damage and healing Malthael for 25 per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Wraith Strike
abilities.text: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59 damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

abilities.name: Death Shroud
abilities.text: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Tormented Souls
abilities.text:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.text:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

1.name: Death's Reach
1.text: Increase Wraith Strike's range by 35%.

1.name: On a Pale Horse
1.text: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

1.name: Fear the Reaper
1.text: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

4.name: Die Alone
4.text: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

4.name: Throwing Shade
4.text:
Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30.

Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

4.name: Black Harvest
4.text:
Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 150 seconds.

Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

7.name: Cold Hand
7.text: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Massacre
7.text: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

7.name: Touch of Death
7.text: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

10.name: Tormented Souls
10.text:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

10.name: Last Rites
10.text:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

13.name: Soul Siphon
13.text: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

13.name: Ethereal Existence
13.text: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

13.name: Inevitable End
13.text: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

13.name: Shroud of Wisdom
13.text: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

16.name: Soul Collector
16.text: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

16.name: Mortality
16.text: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

16.name: Memento Mori
16.text: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

20.name: Reaper of Souls
20.text:
Increase the duration of Tormented Souls to 6 seconds, and while Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh its duration.

If 2 or more enemy Heroes are in Tormented Souls' radius, it does not decay.

20.name: Angel of Death
20.text: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

20.name: Final Curtain
20.text: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

20.name: No One Can Stop Death
20.text: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.
